Grace's birthday is in May. David hopes to visit Paris one day. David bought a pair of shoes at the shop yesterday. The teenagers hang out at the mall.
David thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. David wrote about the day in the diary. It takes twenty minutes to get to the family kitchen by bike. The food here is great.
Life is full of small surprises. The weather was snowy that day. David learned a lot about history. In fact, we eat dumplings at Spring Festival.
